title: Finitely many bounded integer polyhedral chains meet a compact set
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, K ⊆ ℝ^P compact and Λ ∈ ℝ. Consider the currents T ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) for which there are a finite set s of index pairs p = (ι, b) (ι : Fin k → Fin P strictly increasing) and integers β_p with: Φ_p(y) ∈ K for some y ∈ [0,1]^k (each p ∈ s); Σ_{p∈s}|β_p| ≤ Λ; and T(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} β_p ∫_{(0,1)^k} ω(Φ_p y)(e_ι) dy for all ω. The set of such T is finite.
